name: Aries
origin: Aries is the first astrological sign in the zodiac, originating from the constellation of Aries. In Greek mythology, Aries represents the golden ram that rescued Phrixus and Helle.

name: Taurus
origin: Taurus is the second astrological sign and is associated with the constellation Taurus. In Greek mythology, it represents Zeus disguised as a white bull to seduce Europa.

name: Gemini
origin: Gemini is represented by the twins Castor and Pollux from Greek mythology, symbolizing duality and versatility. The constellation represents these twin brothers.

name: Cancer
origin: Cancer is associated with the crab that Hera sent to distract Hercules during his battle with the Hydra. The constellation Cancer represents this brave crustacean.

name: Leo
origin: Leo represents the Nemean Lion defeated by Hercules as his first labor. Zeus placed it in the sky to commemorate Hercules' victory.

name: Virgo
origin: Virgo is associated with Astraea, the goddess of justice, or Demeter, the goddess of agriculture. The constellation represents purity and virtue.

name: Libra
origin: Libra is the only zodiac sign represented by an inanimate object - the scales. It's associated with Themis, the Greek goddess of justice and divine law.
personality_traits: Can be indecisive and avoidant of confrontation

name: Scorpio
origin: Scorpio is associated with the scorpion sent by Gaia to kill Orion. Both the scorpion and Orion were placed in the sky as constellations, forever chasing each other.

name: Sagittarius
origin: Sagittarius represents Chiron, the wise centaur from Greek mythology who was a teacher and healer. The constellation depicts a centaur archer.

name: Capricorn
origin: Capricorn is represented by the sea-goat, a mythological creature with the body of a goat and tail of a fish. It's associated with the god Pan who transformed to escape Typhon.

name: Aquarius
origin: Aquarius is represented by the water bearer. In Greek mythology, it's associated with Ganymede, who was carried to Mount Olympus by Zeus to serve as cupbearer to the gods.

name: Pisces
origin: Pisces represents two fish tied together, symbolizing Aphrodite and Eros who transformed into fish to escape the monster Typhon. They tied themselves together to avoid separation.
personality_traits: Can be overly trusting and escapist
